responsibility: This file contains OpenMP/OpenACC handling that is specific to device offloading and implements the device-lowering passes. It maintains the offload function/variable tables emitted at file scope, analyzes and propagates declare target semantics, manages OpenACC function attributes and loop partitioning metadata, lowers offload- and SIMT-related internal functions and target-specific device constructs in GIMPLE, adjusts host/device linkage details such as 'omp declare target link', and produces the bookkeeping needed for host-target registration and offloaded code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements offloading-specific behavior: it owns the offload function/variable tables, declare-target discovery and finalization, OpenACC device-lowering logic, SIMT/internal-function lowering, and the target-link pass. Unlike gcc/omp-offload.h, it is the implementation and storage site for this offload machinery rather than just its declarations.
